talks.title: Opening Remarks
talks.teaser: Covers the single-track format, venue logistics, safety rules and the origin story behind the event.
talks.summary:
The opening session of the 2022 conference is run by its organizers, who thank staff, sponsors and student attendees and note that attendance is a bit lower than usual. The event moves to a single track this year, partly as a fallback in case it had to shift online. Attendees are pointed to the village rooms, contests, the badge-based charity t-shirt sales and the program schedule.

Much of the middle is practical guidance: masks and badges on the show floor, etiquette for eating and drinking, expectations during a fire alarm evacuation, parking discounts and the email address for real emergencies. The organizers describe running vaccine validation in-house with a staff handbook instead of a third party. They also cover photography rules, including asking permission before taking group shots and not posting audience selfies.

Toward the end, the organizers tell the story of how the event began, as a loose circle of friends who grew frustrated with a conference moment and decided to run their own. They close by urging attendees to pace themselves, ask questions of the staff, give feedback and use the event to learn and connect. The practical takeaway is simple: know the rules, use the help desks, and treat the conference as a place to build knowledge and relationships.
